name: msc_client_ready_parallel_pre
signature:
\lemma msc_client_ready_parallel_pre {S : gFunctors}
    (H : irisGS natCountable S) (G : mscG S) (gam : msc_name)
    (gamM gamD : gname) (base : Nat) (c h1 h2 : Value) :
  \let
    | Public => msc_client_public H G gam gamM gamD base
    | C => msc_is_counter H G gam c
    | H1 => msc_handle G gam h1
    | H2 => msc_handle G gam h2
    | E1 => ghost_map_elem (msc_clientGS G gamM) 1 (0, gamD)
    | E2 => ghost_map_elem (msc_clientGS G gamM) 2 (0, gamD)
    | Ready => Public ∗ (E1 ∗ E2)
    | Frame => C ∗ (H1 ∗ H2)
    | Pre1 => Public ∗ (C ∗ (H1 ∗ E1))
    | Pre2 => Public ∗ (C ∗ (H2 ∗ E2))
  \in (Ready ∗ Frame) ⊢
      (Pre1 ∗ Pre2)

      (msc_read_post H G gam c (msc_client_read_Q G gam base))

name: msc_two_incr_twice_read_result_spec
signature:
\lemma msc_two_incr_twice_read_result_spec {S : gFunctors}
    (H : irisGS natCountable S) (G : mscG S) (SG : spawnG S)
    (FPI : ForkPostInhabited H) (gam : msc_name)
    (gamM gamD : gname) (base : Nat) (c h1 h2 : Value) :
  \let
    | Public => msc_client_public H G gam gamM gamD base
    | C => msc_is_counter H G gam c
    | H1 => msc_handle G gam h1
    | H2 => msc_handle G gam h2
    | E1 => ghost_map_elem (msc_clientGS G gamM) 1 (0, gamD)
    | E2 => ghost_map_elem (msc_clientGS G gamM) 2 (0, gamD)
    | Pre1 => Public ∗ (C ∗ (H1 ∗ E1))
    | Pre2 => Public ∗ (C ∗ (H2 ∗ E2))
  \in (Pre1 ∗ Pre2) ⊢
      (WP H mscE
        (app3 (Val msc_two_incr_twice_read)
          (Val c) (Val h1) (Val h2))
        (\lam returned =>
          mkProperPure (returned = natV (base Nat.+ 4))))

        (a : A1.E) (b : B1.E)

        (ca' : Maybe A2.E) (hca' : pcore {A2} (f.ofe_mor_car a) = ca')
        (cb : Maybe B1.E) (hcb : pcore {B1} b = cb)
        (cb' : Maybe B2.E) (hcb' : pcore {B2} (g.ofe_mor_car b) = cb')
      : (OptionOFE (ProdOFE A2 B2)).equiv
          (maybe_fmap (\lam x => (f.ofe_mor_car x.1, g.ofe_mor_car x.2))
            (\case ca, cb \with {
              | just ax, just bx => just (ax, bx)
              | _, _ => nothing
            }))
          (\case ca', cb' \with {

            | _, _ => nothing

signature:
\lemma pm_wp_inv {cnt : Countable Loc} {S : gFunctors}
    (H : irisGS cnt S) (E : coPset) (N : Namespace) (P : iProp S)
    (e : Expr) (Phi : Value -> iProp S)
    (hNE : coPSubset (nclose N) E) (atomic : StronglyAtomic {cnt} e)
    {envs : PMEnvs (iResUR S)} (selection : PMSelection envs.spatial)
    (body_name close_name : PMName)
    (instance : PMIntoInvariant selection.selected_prop H.iris_wsat N P)
    (next : envs_entails
      (\new PMEnvs (iResUR S) {
        | intuitionistic => envs.intuitionistic
        | spatial => pm_snoc
            (pm_snoc selection.selected_rest body_name (|> P))
            close_name
            ((|> P) -∗
              (mkProperFUpd H.iris_wsat
                (coPset_difference E (nclose N)) E mkProperEmp))
      })
      (pm_wp H (coPset_difference E (nclose N)) e
        (\lam v => mkProperFUpd H.iris_wsat
          (coPset_difference E (nclose N)) E (Phi v))))
  : envs_entails envs (pm_wp H E e Phi)

    (H : irisGS cnt S) (E : coPset) (P : iProp S)

    (wp H E NewProph (\lam w =>
      mkProperExist ProphId (\lam p =>
        mkProperExist (List ProphPayload) (\lam resolves =>
          (mkProperPure (w = LitV (LitProphecy p))) ∧
            proph H.iris_proph_map p resolves))))

name: proofmode_wp_resolve_rule
signature:
\lemma proofmode_wp_resolve_rule {cnt : Countable Loc} {S : gFunctors}
    (H : irisGS cnt S) (E : coPset) (l : Loc) (old new : Value)
    (p : ProphId) (w : Value) (resolves : List ProphPayload) :
  ((pointsto_full H.iris_gen_heap l old) ∗
      (proph H.iris_proph_map p resolves)) ⊢
    (wp H E
      (Resolve (Store (Val (LitV (LitLoc l))) (Val new))
        (Val (LitV (LitProphecy p))) (Val w))
      (\lam returned =>
        mkProperExist (List ProphPayload) (\lam remaining =>
          (mkProperPure
            (\Sigma (returned = LitV LitUnit)
              (resolves = (LitV LitUnit, w) :: remaining))) ∗
